description: Server-side script for managing recurring invoices in a SvelteKit application, including loading data, creating, updating, deleting, and toggling invoice status via API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and processes recurring invoices and related account data for display, handling filtering, pagination, and transformation of server response.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new recurring invoice based on submitted form data.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing recurring invoice using form data and a specified ID.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes a recurring invoice identified by ID.

methods.name: actions.toggle
methods.description: Toggles the status (active/inactive) of a specified recurring invoice.
